title_en: Villa for sale in Residence Montclair, Mjull-Bathore
description_en: A villa is offered for sale in Residence Montclair, Mjull-Bathore. The villa has a plot area of 391 m2 and a total construction area of 343.8 m2, divided as follows: Floor -1: 107 m2 Floor 0: 107 m2 Floor 1: 118.4 m2 Veranda: 11.4 m2 Organization: Floor -1: consists of 3 rooms suitable for gym, storage, office or other uses according to the needs of buyers and 2 toilets. Floor 0: includes a separate kitchen, a living room together with a dining area with direct access to the veranda and 1 toilet. 1st floor: organized in 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The property offers functional organization and suitable spaces for family living, in a residence with high residential standards. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
